author: agent
text: Hand-off from ey47.4 review: do NOT carry endorsements/tiers across keys based on verify_person alone; it is snapshot-only and accepts a file whose old keys were all retired and a new key added signed only by the new key. Rotation rule (prior current key must sign key-set changes, via git history) is an open owner question. Also: verify_person ignores revocations; proposed policy is reject a person file listing a revoked key with retired=null.
